responsibility: Defines the main IA-64 HP-UX subtarget configuration, covering preprocessor builtins, driver specs, ABI defaults, assembler and linker integration, section directives, profiling hooks, stack-checking settings, and HP-UX-specific relocation and library behavior. It enables HP-UX ABI quirks such as ILP32 defaulting, ptr-extension semantics, special startup and library search paths, delayed extern emission for the HP linker, custom pragma registration, and alternate target hooks for function sections, relocations, math libfunc availability, and profiling.
